title: Mount Jerome
html_source: Mount Jerome is located in the heart of the suburb of Harold’s Cross which is centrally located on the south side of Dublin city, just beyond the grand canal. Mount Jerome was the first privately owned cemetery in Ireland, when it first opened in 1836.

anchor.prefix: ways. Dull eye: collar tight on his neck, pressing on a bloodvessel or something. Do they know what they cart out here every day? Must be twenty or thirty funerals every day. Then
anchor.suffix:
for the protestants. Funerals all over the world everywhere every minute. Shovelling them under by the cartload doublequick. Thousands every hour. Too many in the world. 

 Mourne
